root_cause: The Tab component's _activate method does not move focus to the newly activated tab after blurring the previous tab, causing keyboard navigation with ArrowRight/ArrowLeft to lose focus.
repair_strategy: Add element.focus() in the complete callback of _activate after setting aria-selected true, ensuring the tab receives focus once it becomes active.
expected_accessibility_effect: ArrowRight and ArrowLeft keys will move focus to the adjacent tab and update aria-selected accordingly, satisfying keyboard operability requirements for a tablist (WCAG 2.1.1, 2.4.3).
functional_risks: Duplicate focus calls when a tab is activated via mouse click (button already focuses), but focus() is harmless.
Potential change in behavior for callers who rely on blur patterns; unlikely to break existing usage.
verification_requirements: Press ArrowRight from the Account tab: focus moves to Notifications tab and aria-selected becomes true.
Press ArrowLeft from the Billing tab: focus moves to Notifications tab and aria-selected becomes true.
Programmatic invocation of tab.show() results in the tab receiving focus.
Mouse clicks on tabs continue to work and maintain focus.
Keyboard navigation wraps correctly at the ends of the tablist.
